"""Tests for document-request create/update with items.

Regression: the API `items` field is read-only, so creating a request never
persisted its items and required a `title`. A write-only `items_needed` list now
creates/replaces DocumentRequestItem rows.
"""
from datetime import timedelta

from django.urls import reverse
from django.utils import timezone
from rest_framework import status
from rest_framework.test import APITestCase

from app.tenants.models import User
from app.clients.models import Client
from app.documents.models import DocumentRequest


class DocumentRequestItemsTests(APITestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.user = User.objects.create(email='admin@req.test', role='ADMIN')
        self.client.force_authenticate(user=self.user)
        self.account = Client.objects.create(name='Acme', client_type='COMPANY')

    def test_create_with_items_needed_persists_item_rows(self):
        resp = self.client.post(
            reverse('doc-requests-list'),
            {
                'client': str(self.account.id),
                'title': '2024 Year-end documents',
                'items_needed': ['Bank statements', 'Paid invoices'],
            },
            format='json',
        )
        self.assertEqual(resp.status_code, status.HTTP_201_CREATED, resp.data)
        # Items come back in the read-only nested `items`.
        labels = sorted(i['label'] for i in resp.data['items'])
        self.assertEqual(labels, ['Bank statements', 'Paid invoices'])
        req = DocumentRequest.objects.get(id=resp.data['id'])
        self.assertEqual(req.items.count(), 2)
        self.assertEqual(req.created_by, self.user)

    def test_create_requires_title(self):
        resp = self.client.post(
            reverse('doc-requests-list'),
            {'client': str(self.account.id), 'items_needed': ['X']},
            format='json',
        )
        self.assertEqual(resp.status_code, status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST)
        self.assertIn('title', resp.data)

    def test_update_items_needed_replaces_rows(self):
        req = DocumentRequest.objects.create(
            client=self.account, title='Initial', created_by=self.user
        )
        req.items.create(label='Old item')
        resp = self.client.patch(
            reverse('doc-requests-detail', args=[req.id]),
            {'items_needed': ['New A', 'New B']},
            format='json',
        )
        self.assertEqual(resp.status_code, status.HTTP_200_OK, resp.data)
        labels = sorted(i['label'] for i in resp.data['items'])
        self.assertEqual(labels, ['New A', 'New B'])
        self.assertFalse(req.items.filter(label='Old item').exists())

    def test_overdue_filter_returns_only_open_dated_past_due(self):
        today = timezone.now().date()
        yesterday = today - timedelta(days=1)
        tomorrow = today + timedelta(days=1)

        overdue = DocumentRequest.objects.create(
            client=self.account, title='Overdue', created_by=self.user,
            due_date=yesterday, status=DocumentRequest.Status.OPEN,
        )
        # Excluded: null due_date, future due_date, non-OPEN status.
        DocumentRequest.objects.create(
            client=self.account, title='No due date', created_by=self.user,
            due_date=None, status=DocumentRequest.Status.OPEN,
        )
        DocumentRequest.objects.create(
            client=self.account, title='Not yet due', created_by=self.user,
            due_date=tomorrow, status=DocumentRequest.Status.OPEN,
        )
        DocumentRequest.objects.create(
            client=self.account, title='Past due but complete', created_by=self.user,
            due_date=yesterday, status=DocumentRequest.Status.COMPLETE,
        )

        resp = self.client.get(reverse('doc-requests-list'), {'overdue': 'true'})
        self.assertEqual(resp.status_code, status.HTTP_200_OK, resp.data)
        ids = [r['id'] for r in resp.data]
        self.assertEqual(ids, [str(overdue.id)])

    def test_without_overdue_param_list_is_unchanged(self):
        today = timezone.now().date()
        DocumentRequest.objects.create(
            client=self.account, title='Overdue', created_by=self.user,
            due_date=today - timedelta(days=1), status=DocumentRequest.Status.OPEN,
        )
        DocumentRequest.objects.create(
            client=self.account, title='Complete', created_by=self.user,
            status=DocumentRequest.Status.COMPLETE,
        )
        resp = self.client.get(reverse('doc-requests-list'))
        self.assertEqual(resp.status_code, status.HTTP_200_OK, resp.data)
        self.assertEqual(len(resp.data), 2)

    def test_mark_complete_accepts_backend_status(self):
        req = DocumentRequest.objects.create(
            client=self.account, title='T', created_by=self.user
        )
        resp = self.client.patch(
            reverse('doc-requests-detail', args=[req.id]),
            {'status': 'COMPLETE'},
            format='json',
        )
        self.assertEqual(resp.status_code, status.HTTP_200_OK, resp.data)
        self.assertEqual(resp.data['status'], 'COMPLETE')
